title: Q-CLAIM-reply-promise: 'a person replies within two working days' has no code behind it
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** claims coverage, every PR and daily
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/claims.json::"id": "reply-promise"
**Status:** open

code-task: repo=ultrastable/ultrastable path=site/worker.js
code-anchor: await env.ASSETS.put("pilot:" + new Date().toISOString()

Drift (CLAIMS-1), found 2026-11-20 while binding site/worker.js: /pilot, /contact and the answer of POST /api/pilot say "a person replies within two working days". pilotApplication() only writes the application to KV under `pilot:<time>:<id>`; nothing in site/, dashboard/ or seed/worker/src reads that prefix, so no loop notices an application and no reply is sent or measured. The coverage patterns do not catch the sentence (the number is spelled out), so it is recorded here by hand.

Fix the code or the words in the same change: either (a) a tick step lists `pilot:` keys, records each as a task for the owner console with its age, and a probe fails when one is older than the promised window, then register the sentence in doctrine/claims.json as id `reply-promise` with that probe; or (b) change the three sentences to what the code does (the application is scored and stored) and register that sentence as `reply-promise`.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation claims --check` exits 0 with claim `reply-promise` registered.
